views.question: Will NVIDIA commence Vera Rubin production shipments in the second half of 2026?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA commences Vera Rubin production shipments between 2026-07-01 and 2026-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA does not commence Vera Rubin production shipments between 2026-07-01 and 2026-12-31.

views.looks_at: First AI factory in the SK Telecom cloud
views.question: Will the first AI factory in the SK Telecom cloud come online by December 31, 2027?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: The first AI factory in the SK Telecom cloud comes online by 2027-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: The first AI factory in the SK Telecom cloud has not come online by 2027-12-31.
